answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 29488 Country: India Title: My mother she has a heart problem for a long time but now the doctors say that she should have a open heart operation as soon as possible,I am requesting that please make dua for my mother and i would like you to give me a dua or wazifaa to read at the time of operation. Question: A.Alykm,Dear sheikh my mother she has a heart problem for a long time but now the doctors say that she should have a open heart operation as soon as possible,I am requesting that please make dua for my mother and i would like you to give me a dua or wazifaa to read at the time of operation.shukran,Jazakallah. Answer ID: 29488 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 239/239/M=1432) Recite the following dua with durood 7-7 times before and after and blow on your mother: أسأل الله العظيم ، رب العرش العظيم أن يشفي والدتي شفاءُ كاملاً . Your mother too should keep on reciting durood. May Almighty Allah cure her completely and make the operation successful! Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
